cards.title: The numbered agenda species
cards.does: Two to four numbered rows are revealed one per word and hold at a named idle.

phases.name: number writes
phases.does: the row's numeral fades in
phases.trigger: the row's own `at` (else STEP after the previous row)

phases.name: rule draws
phases.does: the nib draws the hairline under the row

phases.name: text rises
phases.does: the row's text rises ROW_DY and fades in

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: each row holds on its own phase of the idle (breath by default)

blends.source: E93 an agenda row carries an icon (ruled, not in this painter)

cards.title: The vector map arc species
cards.does: A clothoid arc draws from one place to another on the word, struck with an X when the flow is cut.

phases.name: shaft draws
phases.does: the clothoid draws by length from one place to the other

phases.name: head lands
phases.does: the arrowhead draws over the last share of the clock

phases.name: cut
phases.does: an X is struck at the midpoint and the arc dims (the X does not)

lives.note: from = VECMAP_GULF written out (golden :565); plate must be vecmap

cards.title: The beat-freeze chart exit species
cards.does: (Not built) The chart's final state would freeze as a hit, then a directional cut.

callable.why: compiles with no painter (SPECIES_WHEN: not built; 0 engine hits, no species module)

cards.title: The scribble callout species
cards.does: A hand-drawn ring closes round a number or a point on a chart, with its label popping beside it.

phases.name: circle draws
phases.does: the hand-drawn ellipse draws on by dash

phases.name: label pops
phases.does: the label scales 0.7 -> 1.0 on spEase over 0.25 s
phases.trigger: CALLOUT.LABEL_AT (0.8) x DRAW_S into the draw

phases.name: underline form (alternative)
phases.does: with form: underline, a squiggle stroke draws under the press card's phrase instead

blends.source: squiggle law for the underline form

lives.note: promoted from the engine's own branch (P57 T17 / R26-97): the module registers SPECIES_PAINTERS.callout and is inlined into the engine between KINETICS:BEGIN callout and KINETICS:END

cards.title: The icon chip species
cards.does: A card with one sourced glyph and a label lands on its word and is crossed out on a later word.

phases.name: land
phases.does: the card springs from POP_FROM and falls DROP_PX onto its word, fading in

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: holds on its named idle

phases.name: cross out
phases.does: two X strokes draw one after the other and the card dims

blends.source: the curvature stroke for the X (42 s42.1)

cards.title: The isometric count array species
cards.does: N identical sourced icons arrive in reading order on a 2:1 rhombus lattice and the count is written under them.

phases.name: icons arrive
phases.does: one icon per word lands on the chip's spring in reading order on the 2:1 lattice
phases.trigger: at + i x STEP (or the row's `step`)

phases.name: claim writes
phases.does: the count pops in under the field (0.72 -> 1.0)
phases.trigger: CLAIM_LAG after the last icon settles

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: every cell holds on its own phase of the idle (breath by default)

cards.title: The flow diagram species
cards.does: Two to six named things and the clothoid arrows between them draw on; later one node swaps while the rest stands.

phases.name: frame draws
phases.does: the dashed box draws clockwise from the top-left, dash by dash

phases.name: nodes land
phases.does: chips land one after another on the chip's spring
phases.trigger: BOX_LEAD of the frame's draw, then every NODE_STEP

phases.name: arrows draw
phases.does: clothoid arrows draw one at a time by length; each head lands over the last share of its clock
phases.trigger: EDGE_LAG after the last node lands

phases.name: year stamps
phases.does: the tag springs in at the box's top-right corner

phases.name: swap
phases.does: the named node's landing runs backward and fades, then the new node lands in its place while the rest stand

cards.title: The focus zoom species
cards.does: After a chart or document has entered, the view zooms and pans to one region and holds dead still.

phases.name: zoom + pan
phases.does: scales to the anchor on an in-out ease over the first 1/1.8 of the window

phases.name: hold dead still
phases.does: the servo law: no drift once there

cards.title: The declared life species
cards.does: Nothing is drawn: a declaration that the world animates on its own (a rendered clip, the outro), credited by the motion gate.

lives.note: SPECIES_KINDS 'life' (the template draws nothing; gate credit)

cards.title: The vector map light species
cards.does: A named country on the vector map fills with the accent on its word and holds.

phases.name: light up
phases.does: the country's fill rises to the accent

phases.name: hold breathing
phases.does: the fill's opacity breathes with the idle's scale

phases.name: light down
phases.does: the fill leaves

blends.source: E56 a fill, never a ring

cards.title: The newsreel band species
cards.does: The sourced headlines crawl in a band in the lower 40 % under a surface that shows who said it.

phases.name: band opens
phases.does: the band scales up from a hairline about its foot on the spring

phases.name: crawl
phases.does: the sourced headlines crawl right to left

phases.name: strap writes
phases.does: the strapline writes under the crawl

phases.name: retreat
phases.does: the band closes and fades

blends.source: E84 the crawl yields to the caption
E68 external material on a surface

options.means: Caption above the crawl: On 9:16 the news crawl takes the caption's own strip and the caption moves above it; refused unless a surface is docked above the band.

lives.note: row: headlines must be sourced titles

cards.title: The plate life species
cards.does: The cutouts on a bare world plate step at 10 fps - throw, land with squash, two-frame boil - so the plate never goes still.

phases.name: throw and land
phases.does: each cutout drops 220 px on spEase with a squash near the end, staggered 0.15 s per cutout
phases.trigger: at + cutout.delay + index x 0.15, on the stepped clock

phases.name: boil
phases.does: a two-frame seeded jitter of position and rotation, forever

cards.title: The pull-back reveal species
cards.does: The hook holds on one large number, then one decelerating pull-back reveals the headline around it.

cards.title: The camera punch species
cards.does: The camera pushes in on one named object that just landed, holds, and eases back out.

phases.name: push in
phases.does: the camera scales up about the target on a cubic ease

phases.name: hold
phases.does: held at the punched scale

phases.name: ease out
phases.does: scales back to 1 on the cubic ease
phases.trigger: PUNCH_OUT before the window's end (at + dur)

blends.source: E51 a push-in tied to a landing

cards.title: The feathered spotlight species
cards.does: The frame dims except a feathered light that lands on a picture or datum and holds for the sentence.

phases.name: dim in
phases.does: the frame dims to SPOT_DIM around a feathered hole, fading in on spEase over 0.4 s

phases.name: glide
phases.does: the hole glides from target to target2 on spIO over 0.6 s

phases.name: hold alive
phases.does: the hole's radius breathes and its centre drifts by the named idle
phases.trigger: after the glide, until the window ends (dur 'hold' resolves to the sentence)

phases.name: dim out
phases.does: fades out over the last 0.4 s
